items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Robert Patterson. [INTERVIEWEE] No, it's Robert Masters...

ctx.x: Robert Masters -- he doesn't handle Teddy but he handles Benny Carter from time to time, Buddy Tate, Lockjaw Davis --
